title: Executive Director
description:
Lead corruption prevention, awareness, and policy functions
Oversee communications, media relations, and stakeholder engagement
Shape ICAC's public trust and strategic evolution
A Career of Integrity: Join the Papua New Guinea ICAC
The
Independent Commission Against Corruption (ICAC)
, established by the Constitution and the
Organic Law on the ICAC 2020
(
OLICAC
), is the lead agency dedicated to
preventing, reducing, and combating corrupt conduct
across Papua New Guinea. They offer a career of profound national impact, demanding the highest standards of
integrity, professionalism, and courage
. Join the organisation to be an integrity role model and shape the future of a vital national institution.
They are seeking exceptional, experienced professionals to fill this pivotal
Executive Director
role to lead a core operational and strategic division. As a member of ICAC’s senior executive team, you will provide strategic direction and operational oversight to drive the Commission’s mandate.
Drive National Change Through Prevention and Awareness
Our client is looking for a dynamic and strategic leader for the role of
Executive Director, Prevention and Engagement (P&E) Division
. This role is responsible for leading all corruption prevention, awareness, and education activities, alongside internal and external communications, policy development, and domestic/international stakeholder engagement.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the development and implementation of anti-corruption
prevention, awareness, and education
programs.
Provide strategic advice and executive leadership on the division's operation and direction.
Oversee
internal and external communications
, including media relations and brand implementation.
Lead
domestic and international stakeholder engagement
and the ICAC’s events function.
Develop and implement processes for the creation of
government policies
and strategic documents.
Key Requirements
Minimum tertiary qualification Bachelor’s Degree in Policy, Communications, Law, Social Sciences or relevant fields.
Minimum
10 years’ experience
with
7 years in a senior management
role
Vast experience in
anti-corruption risk assessment, governance, communications, and stakeholder engagement
.
Good understanding and experience in implementing
corruption prevention
practices.
Demonstrated
leadership
and extensive
people and change management
skills.
High level of oral and written communication
and strong analytical skills.
Apply Now to Make a Difference
If you are a strategic, values-driven leader ready to build and drive the ICAC’s public face and its preventative mandate, apply today.
Only applicants committed to the highest ethical standards need apply.
Applications close at 5:00 PM, 14th November 2025.
Female candidates are strongly encouraged to apply
